<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Take the information below and generate an agent instructions .md file for it in the /docs directory. If a .md filename is provided, use that, otherwise generate an appropriate filename based on the generated content. The instructions should be concise, clear, and specific to the layer of architecture or coding standards described in the input. Make sure to update the AGENTS.md file to reference this new docs file. If no information is provided below, prompt the user to give the necessary details about the layer of architecture or coding standards for which the instructions should be generated.
